text: SOLUTION We leave the computation of the limits used in the limit comparison test (page 104 in the workbook) to the reader. The way the series are connected is: A < 1 both series diverge because series A diverges by the p-test. C + 2 both series converge because series C converges by the p-test. A 3 both series diverge because series A diverges by the p-test. D <+ 4 both series diverge because series D diverges by the p-test.
